question: Which of the following is the autobiography of Abul Kalam Azad, the first Education Minister of free India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**India Wins Freedom**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **India Wins Freedom** is the autobiography of Abul Kalam Azad, the first Education Minister of free India.
 
• Maulana Abul Kalam Azad was a senior leader of the Indian National Congress and played a crucial role in India's struggle for independence.
 
• He was a prominent freedom fighter and an influential leader in the Indian independence movement against British rule.
 
• His autobiography provides a detailed account of his experiences and the events leading up to India's independence.
 
• Abul Kalam Azad's contributions to education in India are significant, and he laid the foundation for the country's educational system.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Abul Kalam Azad was also a renowned scholar and a prolific writer, and his works continue to inspire many in India and around the world.
 
• In addition to his role in politics and education, Azad was a strong advocate for Hindu-Muslim unity and worked tirelessly to promote communal harmony.
 
• His efforts were recognized posthumously, and he was awarded the Bharat Ratna, India's highest civilian award, in 1992.
 
• The Ministry of Education in India celebrates National Education Day on November 11, the birth anniversary of Abul Kalam Azad, to honor his contributions to the field of education.
 
• Azad's legacy lives on through numerous institutions and programs named after him, reflecting his enduring impact on Indian society.
